This appendix reports the item-level calibration of the post-broadcast epis-
temic experience battery (PB1 to PB5) on the rened eld sample (N = 52). It
supplies the inter-item statistics, reliabilities, and collapse decisions referenced under
H3.
B.1
Protocol
The calibration protocol species that any pair of items producing r > 0.90 with each
other is a collapse candidate (rule R1): the pair is reviewed for conceptual overlap
before any scoring change. A high correlation alone does not justify merging distinct
constructs. Corrected item-total correlations are reported against the retention oor
of r ≥0.30.

Item-Level Diagnostics
B.3
Collapse Decision
One collapse candidate pair is measured: PB1 (epistemic condence) with PB4
(structural clarity), r = 0.918, exceeding the 0.90 rule of the protocol.
For the
current wave all ve items remain in the reported composite.
A future version
should examine whether condence and perceived structural clarity are substantively
redundant before merging them. This is a proposed revision, not a scoring change
applied retrospectively to the supplied analysis.
The item means and standard
deviations are now also reproduced from the supplied 52 response records.
The
historical pairwise Pearson correlations also match the response matrix; the item
labels have been corrected against F1.0. No item has been merged.
